name: The Hollow Fleet
description: A fleet of ancient automated warships wakes at a remote derelict anchorage and patrols a fixed route of systems on a repeating schedule. It attacks only the ships and bases in the system it is in, and ignores everything else. Watch it, learn its route and schedule, and keep out of its way, or ambush it.

flags.name: threatHollowFleet
flags.label: The Hollow Fleet
flags.description: Ancient warships patrol a fixed route on a fixed schedule, attacking whatever is in the system they are in.

params.name: hollowFleetYear
params.label: Year the fleet wakes (years into the game)

params.name: hollowFleetStrengthPct
params.label: Fleet strength (% of the median empire's military firepower)

params.name: hollowFleetTechBonus
params.label: Tech level above the galaxy's average

params.name: hollowFleetRouteSystems
params.label: Systems on its route, besides the anchorage (5 to 8)

params.name: hollowFleetTravelSpeed
params.label: Distance covered per day of travel on its route (world units; 0 = the fleet's slowest hyperdrive)

params.name: hollowFleetBounty
params.label: Money bounty for destroying it (to the empire with most kills)

params.name: hollowFleetAmbushPct
params.label: AI ambush: fleet strength an AI needs, as % of the Hollow Fleet's

params.name: hollowFleetAvoidDays
params.label: AI keeps civilian ships and fleets out of a known stop this many days before its arrival

params.name: hollowFleetExistChancePct
params.label: Chance the fleet exists in this game (%; -1 = use the shared value)

params.name: hollowFleetMinYear
params.label: Earliest year it may wake (-1 = use the shared value)
